generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A control suite can appear exhaustive while all siblings share the same shape, allowing cardinality or nesting to become a hidden proxy; explicit non-code impacts can likewise be omitted from active risk families when coverage follows the diff instead of the specification.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Vary only lexical values inside one-token fixtures and classify a required documentation impact as not applicable because the latest code delta is localized.
trigger_signals: open class with siblings sharing one cardinality
nested or wrapped inputs with default decisions
token-count or length branch in semantic classification
explicit documentation impact paired with documentation not-applicable
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: For open classes, vary cardinality, depth and composition across sibling controls and reject token length as semantic proof; derive active risk families from explicit specification impacts, including documentation, not only from the latest code diff.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Attack open-set controls with multi-token and nested siblings plus an out-of-catalog positive boundary, and fail saturation whenever an explicit canonical documentation obligation is marked not applicable.
